_about: Settings for the job-application pipeline (see automation/APPLY.md and automation/RUNBOOK.md). Edit here, never in the scripts. The access code is never stored in this repo: scripts read it from the TRACKER_CODE environment variable or the file named in code_file.

schedule.discover: Once a day, early morning Melbourne time. Adverts are found within hours already; more sweeps add cost, not applications.
schedule.submit: Twice a day while the apply queue is not empty (morning and early afternoon Melbourne time), never between 21:00 and 07:00.
schedule._note: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: the goal is submitted applications, not leads. Each runner keeps its own trigger; this file sets the cadence they follow.

prefilter._note: 13 Nov 2026: 'laboratory' removed from the exclusions (it threw away entry-level construction materials testing jobs unread); non-civil laboratory words added instead. Estimator, project coordinator, student-only and graduate-program titles are now excluded (config -> lanes -> excluded).

fit.rubric: First decide the lane from the duties (config -> lanes); an advert in no lane is rejected, whatever it scores. Then score against automation/facts.json only. Start at 50. Add up to +25 for entry level (the advert says junior, trainee, cadet, graduate, entry level, no experience needed or training provided; an advert that states two or more years scores 0 here). Add up to +15 for duty overlap with the lane (drafter: civil drawings in AutoCAD or Civil 3D, roads, earthworks, drainage, subdivision; technician: testing, sampling, inspections, site work, records; engineer: site coordination, inspections, quality checks, drawings). Add +10 if it is lane 1 or lane 2. Subtract 40 for a mandatory requirement he cannot meet: citizenship or PR, 'no temporary visas', a licence or ticket he lacks, a named Australian degree, a stated minimum of two or more years called essential, current enrolment. Subtract 10 if the advertiser is a recruitment agency with no named employer. Words such as ideally, preferred, desirable, advantageous and typically are gaps, not mandatory. Never guess: an unknown detail is a gap to note, not a fail and not a hold. The result is a rough fit, not an interview forecast.
fit.decisions: APPLY (65 or more, nothing mandatory unmet, every form question answerable from facts.json -> answers), ASK_OWNER (65 or more but one question or fact is missing: one line to the owner, at most three open at a time), REJECT (everything else, with the reason). There is no HELD state for new adverts.

limits._about: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: count submitted applications with a receipt. There is no quota of new records per tick; a tick that finds nothing new is a valid result.
limits._removed: target_new_records_min, max_new_records_per_run, max_emails_per_run, contact_research_max_per_run and the 14-day widening step (13 Nov 2026).

banned_phrases: i am writing to express my interest
i believe i would be a great fit
i look forward to the possibility
tone.banned_character_note: No em or en dashes in emails or letters; use a comma, a full stop or 'to'. Date ranges in the letter use 'to'.

no_volunteered_limits.rule: An email, letter or free-text answer never says what he lacks, never apologises for coursework, and never gives the visa end date unless the advert asks about visa or residency. If a mandatory criterion is unmet the advert is rejected instead.

tone.letter_shape: Three short paragraphs: (1) the role and one true, specific line from the advert; (2) what he has done, matched to the advert's top two tasks; (3) where he is, work rights in the short form, start in two weeks, one clear ask.

contact.rule: A direct contact is a named person in an engineering, drafting, design, operations, project or owner/director role at the employer whose business email is published by the employer itself (website team or contact page, project page, capability statement PDF, press release, tender or council document authored by the employer). Record the evidence URL and the date checked.
never: use a personal (gmail, hotmail, outlook) address
use data brokers, lead-generation or email-finder services
use recruiters, agencies or unrelated project parties
use a generic info@ or admin@ inbox unless the employer says it accepts applications
fallback_order: employer HR, careers or application inbox that explicitly accepts applications
SEEK apply by the SEEK submitter or the employer portal by the portal submitter (automation/APPLY.md)
contact.double_touch: Retired 13 Nov 2026: one application per advert through the channel the employer asks for.
contact.when: Contact research only when the advert itself names a person or an application email, or for the weekly speculative approaches. Adverts that take applications through SEEK or a portal get no contact research.

sending.channel: Gmail (the owner's own address) through the Gmail connector of the runner named in automation/APPLY.md as email sender; no other channel is allowed
sending.authority: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: email applications are sent automatically, without per-email approval, inside the daily cap.
sending.lock: automation/queue/SEND_LOCK.json through 'queue.py lock take' and 'queue.py lock release', committed and pushed before the send (automation/APPLY.md section 6).
sending.queue_statuses: OPEN (waiting), ASK_OWNER (needs one answer), UNCERTAIN (unknown whether it went: never retried until checked), APPLIED (receipt recorded), SKIPPED, EXPIRED, FAILED. A sent email is APPLIED with receipt kind gmail_message_id.
sending.tracker_statuses: Tracker records made before 13 Nov 2026 use PREPARED_NOT_SENT, SENDING, SENT, SEND_UNCERTAIN and DELIVERY_FAILED; read them as history.

target_employers._note: Employer names only. The tick resolves careers pages with WebSearch/WebFetch and caches what it verified in automation/employers.json. Small and mid-sized civil firms first: they read direct email.
names: Department of Transport and Planning Victoria
Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads

statuses._legacy: READY_JEREMIE_SEEK, READY_JEREMIE_EMPLOYER_PORTAL and READY_JEREMIE_EMPLOYER_FORM appear on records made before 13 Nov 2026 and mean the same as the READY_* names above. Jeremie is no longer involved (owner, 13 Nov 2026).

_budget: Fewest agents that give the same result: one sweep agent, one screening agent, one reviewer for anything that will be sent or submitted. No contact-research fan-out. No panels.

lanes._about: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: apply only for work his qualifications support. Lane order is queue order. The duties decide the lane, not the title: read the advert.

drafter.what: Civil drafting and design under an engineer: civil drafter, draftsperson, civil designer, road, drainage, stormwater, subdivision or land-development designer, CAD or Civil 3D technician, structural drafter. Junior, trainee and cadet versions first. This is the work the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design trains for.
drafter.not: Steel shop detailing, truss detailing, joinery, kitchen, architectural-only or mechanical drafting.

technician.what: Civil engineering technician work: construction materials testing (soil, concrete, asphalt, aggregates), civil or geotechnical laboratory and field technician, civil engineering assistant, engineering technical officer whose duties are testing, inspection or design support. Entry-level and trainee adverts are common here.
technician.not: Medical, pathology, food, water-chemistry or environmental-science laboratories; mine geology sampling.

engineer.what: Graduate or junior civil, site or project engineer where the advert itself welcomes graduates or asks for no more than one year, at small and mid-size contractors, land-development consultancies and councils.
engineer.not: Formal graduate programs (closed until about March 2027: citizen or PR rules, degree-recency rules, intakes already shut), bare Site, Project or Civil Engineer titles that ask for two or more years, recruitment agencies unless the advert is for a graduate or cadet.

what: student, intern, vacation or undergraduate roles
excluded.why: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: only skilled work his qualifications support. Labouring, traffic control, survey-assistant and clerical roles are out; estimator and project coordinator are different occupations. The owner can re-open a family by saying so.

sweep_rotation_note: One sweep agent per daily tick on the rotation: (1) national and local construction materials testing and geotechnical firms' careers pages, (2) land-development and civil design consultancies and subdivision contractors, (3) council and state agency job boards for technical, design and asset officer roles. Read duties before queueing.
costs: Owner, 13 Nov 2026: everything stays on free plans (GitHub, Cloudflare). No agent adds a paid service or plan without asking him first.
